verdict.rationale: Heap documents its own server-side APIs for tracking events (single and bulk), identifying users, adding user and account properties, and deleting users, so part of the product is programmable. Nothing in the pack shows API access to the main UI capabilities: charts, reports, event definitions, session replay, Sense Chat, alerts or CSV exports. No OpenAPI spec was found either, so parity with the UI is far from shown. Missing for 10: API access to analysis, reports and charts; programmatic management of event definitions and projects; session replay API; a published OpenAPI spec; evidence of UI–API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
